_readme: OSHIVA PII / secret redaction (see AI_PII_REDACTION.md). Copy to 'redaction.json' (same folder;
git-ignored) only if you need to extend it — the built-in defaults already redact DB passwords,
connection strings, tokens, and personal data (first/sur/last name, email, username, GUID, account
number). This file can only ADD to those lists, never shrink them.
enabled           : master on/off (default true). Leave true.
placeholder       : the marker that replaces a sensitive value.
redact_values     : also mask value patterns (emails, inline 'password=...') in free text.
extra_secret_keys : extra column/field names to treat as SECRETS (value fully removed).
extra_pii_keys    : extra column/field names to treat as PII.
